content: धारिन् {%a.%} (-णी|{%f.%}) [धृ-णिनि] .²1 Carrying, bearing, sustaining, preserving, having, holding, supporting; पादाम्भोरुहधारि <ls>Gīt. 12</ls>; कर˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Keeping in oneʼs memory, possessed of retentive memory; अज्ञेभ्यो ग्रन्थिनः श्रेष्ठा ग्रन्थिभ्यो धारिणो वराः <ls>Ms. 12. 103</ls>. .²3 Edged, observing, doing; यज्ञधारी च सततम् <ls>Mb. 12. 340. 1</ls>.
